program.name: CS Quest
program.tagline: Computer science, one period at a time.
program.standards: CSTA K-12 CS Standards 2017, levels 1B (grades 3-5) and 2 (grades 6-8)

params.tokenField: o = chapter.band.mode.level.lock (<= 40 chars, empty parts allowed)
params.sdk: BRB.params frozen object, {} when absent; games read (window.BRB && BRB.params) || {}
params.stepColumn: lesson_steps.options holds the query-string form; routes/progress.js appends it to the Play link
params.questCode: C B M L (4 digits): C chapter index (0 map), B 1 Explorer | 2 Pro, M mode index (0 play, 1 debug, 2 maker/tally/wheel, 3 projector), L level 0-9; typed in-game; params win; hidden in live frames

stores.step_progress: status/score/label/plays/seconds/answer/feedback/marks per class_lesson x step x user (existing); marks reused for 0-3 rubric lines on question/build steps (new)
stores.lesson_steps.options: NEW TEXT: query-string params appended to the Play link (chapter=&band=&mode=&level=&lock=)
stores.lesson_steps.standards: NEW TEXT: comma list of CSTA ids set by the materialiser
stores.lesson_steps.template: NEW TEXT: Studio template key for build steps (quiz)
stores.lesson_steps.items[].cat: KEEP cat (+secs) in quiz snapshots (lessons.js addQuizStep)
stores.live_runs.items[].cat: KEEP cat in saved run items (classlive-results.js itemRow)
stores.lessons.template_key / template_version: NEW: which catalogue lesson a library copy came from
stores.live_sets: derived warm-up / exit / review sets per lesson owned by the teacher (existing table)
stores.server/standards/csta.js: NEW: loads csta.json -> id -> {level, concept, subconcept, statement, practiceCodes}
stores.games label: score = starsInChapter, label per Appendix C grammar (existing scores/step_progress columns)
stores.phase2: step_progress.detail TEXT + step_progress_events(class_lesson_id, step_id, user_id, at, detail) capped 200 per cell via brb:progress

tiers.Practiced: students with >= 1 done step whose standards contains the id (+ live_run_scores on runs whose items carry the id)
tiers.Checked: mean per-item accuracy from step_progress.marks x items[i].cat and live_run_scores.marks x live_runs.items[i].cat; shown with item and student counts
tiers.Applied: mean of 0-3 rubric marks on question/build steps whose rubric line carries the id

mastery.student: >= 2 of 3 items right on the most recent exit ticket tagged with the id OR rubric line >= 2

tracking.privacy: teacher/class-manager only; never on projector/results/public pages; per-student drill-down inside the class; deleted with the class (onClassLeave/onAccountMerge); coverage claimed per class (pairs: signed-in student only)

flags.QUIZ_STEPS: NEW, default on: gates quiz-step rendering and /api/lessons/:cl/steps/:step/quiz

tracking.inGameCheck: Case-closed card in lesson mode: 1 concept check (3 tiles, from level.check) + 1 confidence face; tally in the label today, per level with brb:progress
tracking.ciTest: tests/unit/cs-quest-catalogue.test.js clauses (a)-(j) per plan §9.5; scripts/cs-quest-coverage.js prints the map

lockSemantics.lock=1: band locked; chapter map and band toggle hidden; start at chapter; at chapter end lesson mode continues into game.then for the band, else results + Back to class
lockSemantics.scoreUnderChain: chained chapters add stars to score (monotonic); label keeps the locked chapter's noun and totals
lockSemantics.ciClauseFPrime: a game step's standards is a subset of the union of csta of its chapter and its then chapters for the band

withdrawn.csq-2-4.1.mainActivity.first: routes 1-6 (routes level 5 is the Pro Explore demo; routes 5-6 stretch via then)

mastery.problem: 13 ids outside unit 7 never have 2 tagged items on one exit ticket: 1B-AP-08 1B-AP-12 1B-AP-13 1B-AP-14 1B-AP-16 1B-AP-17 1B-IC-20 2-AP-13 2-AP-15 2-AP-16 2-AP-18 2-AP-19 2-CS-01; 1B-AP-08 and 1B-AP-12 have one bank item in total
mastery.checkedRule: >= 2 of the items tagged with the id on the most recent ticket are right, or all of them when fewer than 2 are tagged
mastery.appliedRule: rubric line >= 2 on any question/build step (every lesson has one from the sentence step)
mastery.ciClauseBPrime: >= 3 bank items per id per band

capstone.captainLogin: one Studio game per account per build step: the team captain signs in for every unit-7 period; other members have no build cell
capstone.markTeammates: P11 review form: 'Also mark these teammates' multi-select upserts the rubric marks onto teammates' step_progress rows (question/build steps only)
capstone.spend: free pool $5/day site-wide; a school plan adds seats x $10/12 per month to the shared paid pool (30 seats = $25/month); 15 teams x ~8 turns x 2 periods x $0.15-0.40 = $36-96 per class capstone
capstone.throughput: one serial build runner per instance, maxPerUser 2; ~1-3 min per turn => 15-30 turns per 30-minute block for the whole class = 1-2 turns per team per period
decisions: measure a build turn on production hardware
